summary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with 1 continuing advisory. Custody, exact seven-item carriage, lineage, the explicit P-1/P-2/G3 mapping, the P-2 output-versus-host-authority split, the item-7 decomposition, and every non-application/non-SATISFIED prohibition survive. CLAUDE-PPBS-V4-SF1 is repaired: EE-6b now assigns the disclosure/honesty property to DR-G09 without a conditional, separately says the DR-G09 harness remains unauthored, and makes clear that this is not uncertainty about ownership. The live DR-G09 row confirms exactly that split: harness.DR-G09.permissions.preview-scoped is named, not authored, not QUALIFIED, and the gate owns truthful enforced/disclosed outcomes. PPBSV3-B1 does not regress. EE-5b remains limited to represented pre-stage substitutions; EE-6b remains the D-128 FX-2B disclosure-only shape rather than host confinement; EE-7a still separates aggregate useful-install selection from DR-101 core inventory; and EE-7b still separates the D-002/DR-118 role list from DR-G13 quality evidence. The generic findingDisposition name also repairs the stale v4 field name. The continuing advisory is only precision about overlapping future-prevention ownership: DR-105/DR-G09 owns a permission-cell primitive/evidence change, while register row DR-128 owns post-MVP third-party sandbox product approval. It does not affect the preview result or leave a SHOULD-FIX. DR-117 remains OPEN; nothing is qualified, applied, sealed, or authorized for implementation.
